note: Vol 4 Ch 2. JSON, not YAML, so the stdlib can read it. Targets and thresholds are the lab's choices for the fictional Northwind Goods, not recommendations.

latency.sli: first checked reply within threshold_s of ticket creation
latency.clock: starts when the ticket is created (the 202); stops at the first substantive reply that passed its checks; the 202 and neutral status events do not stop it

quality.sli: sampled replies graded correct by the Vol 2 checks
quality.status: no events until Chapter 4 scores live traffic

admission.metric: tickets created / valid POST /tickets attempts in the window
admission.note: reported beside the latency SLO, which counts admitted tickets only; a refusal before creation never reaches the latency count

cost_limit.note: a constraint, not an SLO: no budget, a ceiling per ticket

pii_in_reply.rule: no email or phone number in a reply

duplicate_refund.rule: at most one payment per operation_id

policy.when_budget_spent: freeze risky releases; rollbacks and reliability fixes still ship
